questions.stem: A 35year old man Rakesh is having difficulty in reading newspapers since last 6 months but his symptoms have worsened over the past 1 week. He has developed difficulty in chewing his favourite food (hamburger). He has no sensory complaints and his symptoms are improved significantly after rest. Which of the following is the main reason for his complaints?
questions.stemHtml: A 35year old man Rakesh is having difficulty in reading newspapers since last 6 months but his symptoms have worsened over the past 1 week. He has developed difficulty in chewing his favourite food (hamburger). He has no sensory complaints and his symptoms are improved significantly after rest. Which of the following is the main reason for his complaints?

options.label: A
options.text: Increase in duration of absolute refractory period

options.label: B
options.text: Reduced Ca² + release at the axonal ending

options.label: D
options.text: Decrease in amplitude of Motor End Plate Potential
